mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS cardSpentYtd, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN c.card_type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS creditCardSpentYtd, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN c.card_type = 'CHECK' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS checkCardSpentYtd FROM TRANSACTIONS t INNER JOIN CARDS c ON c.card_id = t.card_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.type = 'EXPENSE' AND t.transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND c.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'CHECK')

SELECT category AS category, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN transaction_date BETWEEN #{currentStartDate} AND #{currentEndDate} THEN amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS currentAmount, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN transaction_date BETWEEN #{previousStartDate} AND #{previousEndDate} THEN amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS previousAmount FROM TRANSACTIONS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'EXPENSE' AND category NOT IN ('INCOME', 'SEND', 'CARD_WITHDRAWAL') AND transaction_date BETWEEN #{previousStartDate} AND #{currentEndDate} GROUP BY category ORDER BY category ASC
